title: Marvel’s Midnight Suns
subtitle: DLC level & encounter design
summary: Designed five Season Pass maps, ten encounters, and their connecting spaces.
description: I worked on the Deadpool, Venom, Morbius, and Storm DLCs, designing two encounters and their connecting spaces in one map per pack. I also designed the bonus finale included with the Season Pass, bringing the total to five maps and ten encounters.

homeCover.alt: Official landscape Season Pass artwork for Marvel’s Midnight Suns, featuring the four DLC heroes

cover.alt: The second combat encounter in the DLC 3 level I worked on, with a circular central arena and surrounding cover
cover.label: DLC 3: second combat encounter

ownership: Designed combat areas and connecting spaces for all four DLC packs and the bonus Season Pass finale.
Planned environmental interactions, knockback paths, and tactical positions around story and combat requirements.
Worked with concept and environment artists through level production, then handled gameplay configuration, bug fixes, and final delivery.
evidence: The second combat encounter in DLC 3. Below are the DLC 2 encounter layouts and paper sketches for DLC 3.

sections.title: DLC 2: stun, AOE, and knockback
sections.intro: I placed environmental interactions to give players tactical choices in these two DLC 2 encounters. The images retain the original annotations from my portfolio slides.

media.label: Stun opportunities
media.caption: Blue circles: stun interactions let players skip a boss turn, easing survival pressure on higher difficulties.
media.alt: DLC 2 encounter with three original blue circles marking stun interactions
media.source: Game screenshot with original slide annotations

media.label: AOE and knockback opportunities
media.caption: Red circles: explosives around enemies that spawn reinforcements give players an AOE option for clearing new enemies. Yellow circles: knockback interactions near fall zones create opportunities for environmental kills.
media.alt: DLC 2 encounter with original red circles on explosives and yellow circles on knockback interactions near fall zones
media.source: Game screenshot with original slide annotations

sections.title: DLC 3: developing two encounters
sections.intro: Each encounter developed from paper sketches into a finished game space. The studies consider combat layout, connections, and the surrounding environment together.
paragraphs: I used paper sketches to work through combat flow and sightlines before expanding the surrounding spaces. The excerpts below are grouped by encounter; click a sketch to see the full notebook page.

sections.title: Positions and knockback paths
sections.intro: With no visible movement grid, players read the environment to judge where they can move and how to line up an attack.

points.title: Playable space
points.text: Planters and environmental edges suggest the boundaries of the space.

points.title: Knockback direction
points.text: Clear paths help players judge where a target will land or collide.

points.title: Interaction placement
points.text: Interactions around enemy positions give players useful attack angles after moving.

outcomes: Delivered five maps, ten encounters, and their connecting spaces across the four DLC packs and the bonus Season Pass level.
The DLC 2 screenshots show the interaction layouts; the DLC 3 sketches and final views show the level’s progress from planning to production.
